_comment: Checkers that NOTHING but their own unit test ever runs (vibe-ic#381). MAY ONLY SHRINK — each entry is a checker with zero coverage of real inputs. `triage` records why an entry is still here; the wrong repair is to delete the test so the entry disappears.
